name: Robin Riker
bio: Robin Riker is an American actress and author. She made her big screen debut in the 1980 horror film Alligator and later went to star in the Showtime comedy series Brothers. Riker had starring roles in a number of sitcoms during 1990s, include Get a Life, Shaky Ground, Thunder Alley, and The Gregory Hines Show.
place: New York City, New York, USA
